basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Infrastructure & Platform Engineer · Cloud (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes, IaC & CI/CD · Robotics & Edge · Founder-Builder
basics.summary: Infrastructure and platform engineer who has built cloud foundations and CI/CD from scratch at startup scale, and shipped code all the way to physical robots. At Dronistics I built the AWS cloud stack, real-time APIs, and deployment pipeline for an autonomous drone fleet: edge devices in the field with a 99.5% safety record and zero incidents. 13+ years across AWS and GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions, with the instrumentation and developer tooling that make a team faster (a templating engine now powering 15% of a platform used by 10M+ users). I have founded three companies, so early-stage ownership and the simple-now, durable-where-it-counts trade-off are second nature.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who ran production services at scale and built the tooling and pipelines that made the team faster.
highlights: Ran production services for 10M+ users on Kubernetes and AWS: containers, secrets, and reliability at scale.
Built CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) for fast, repeatable builds and deploys, including an LLM automation pipeline shipped in 6 weeks.
Built developer tooling and reusable frameworks (a distributed templating engine now powering 15% of platform assets): developer experience that removed friction for the team.

Ran observability and carried on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting across a data stack of Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search and ClickHouse.

Engineered real-time control APIs and connectivity between cloud and robots. 500+ deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents, on partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.
Rolled out over-the-air updates and safe rollbacks to drones in the field, with secure cloud-to-robot connectivity.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Infrastructure Engineer for a stealth robotics / physical-security startup (TechTree's client), Zurich (in-person, remote for exceptional candidates; visa/relocation support). Build the cloud platform connecting a robot fleet to operator intelligence: own cloud setup, deployment pipelines, CI/CD, container orchestration, and secure networking so the team ships code from laptop to robot reliably, securely, at scale. Critical early-stage hire; on-prem deployments to security-sensitive customers, so hardened self-contained deployments matter. Work on: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP, networking, security, IAM, cost controls); secure networking (VPNs, certificate and PKI management, TLS, hardened connectivity between cloud, operators, robots); CI/CD (fast reliable repeatable builds/deploys for cloud and on-robot software); container orchestration (Kubernetes and lightweight K3s for edge/on-prem, image build pipelines, secrets management); edge and fleet management (OTA updates, config management, telemetry, secure connectivity); observability (logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting with Grafana/Prometheus); developer experience (local envs, testing infra, internal tooling); security and compliance (hardening, secrets, audit trails). Background: 4+ years in platform/DevOps/SRE/infrastructure; deep experience with at least one major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure); strong Kubernetes (incl. K3s) and IaC (Terraform, Pulumi); networking and security fundamentals (VPNs, TLS, PKI, firewalls); CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); code in Python, Go, or similar; track record building developer-facing platforms engineers liked using. Nice to have: deploying to edge devices or robot fleets (OTA, A/B updates, rollback); on-prem or air-gapped; security-sensitive environments (enterprise, defense, fintech, healthcare); observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry); ML workloads (training infra, model serving, GPU orchestration).
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit on cloud-infra-from-scratch at startup scale + robotics/edge: Dronistics (built AWS infra and CI/CD from scratch for an autonomous drone fleet, edge devices in the field), EPFL (AWS large-scale compute for robotics/ML), Beekeeper (Kubernetes/AWS at 10M+ users, GitHub Actions/Jenkins CI/CD, secrets, observability, developer tooling), Terraform (published module), founder/early-stage ownership, fintech/security-sensitive (SwissNRI). Honest gaps NOT fabricated: deep network/security engineering (VPN, PKI, TLS, firewalls) is not a demonstrated specialty; no Go, Pulumi, or K3s specifically; observability is via tracing/metrics/dashboards but not Grafana/Prometheus by name; profile is AI/full-stack-leaning rather than a pure SRE/platform specialist. Robotics domain and infra-from-scratch are genuine strengths.
